name: Intellectual Property Office of Singapore

scam_info.sample: Some members of the public have received emails from persons purporting to be from IPOS, informing them of IP infringement with dubious file links, and asking for urgent action.
These companies are private commercial entities. They are not affiliated with the Intellectual Property Office of Singapore (IPOS) or the World Intellectual Property Organization
scam_info.notes: Unsolicited IP registration/renewal invoices (trademark-invoice scam). No company names in the page text.
